titulo: Read-only X-ray: the HTML the server delivers
lead: A search engine doesn't see your site the way you see it in the browser: it reads the HTML the server delivers, almost always without running JavaScript. A 40-line script does that reading for you, without changing anything on the site, and in minutes it shows what no pretty dashboard will.
objetivo: run auditoria.sh on your site and read each line of the output the way a search engine reads it.

aprende.t: Download the inemaSEO method and run the audit
Read redirects, robots.txt, sitemaps, and pages
Find a page with no internal link in the HTML
Turn the output into a list of findings

hero_alt: A technician examines an X-ray against a white light panel.

secoes.sub: Read-only: the script uses curl and changes nothing. Tap each block.

nos.detalhe: You give it the main address and, if you want, a few pages. Start with the home page and two pages that matter to your business.
The script downloads each address the way a robot would: the HTML the server sends. If a link only shows up after JavaScript runs, it won't show up here, and the search engine may not see it either.
Tests the three variations of the address. The right result is all of them leading to the same version (lesson 4).
Shows the whole robots.txt, counts the URLs in each sitemap listed there and how many have hreflang, and tells you whether an llms.txt exists (optional, lesson 6).

For each page: HTTP code, title, canonical, declared languages, meta robots, JSON-LD types, and how many internal links exist in the HTML. The last line is the one that catches the most hidden problems.

secoes.legenda: It ran, saved, read. Nothing changes on the site; the X-ray is the picture before you touch anything.

secoes.titulo: From download to list of findings

texto: inemaSEO is public, under the MIT license. You need a terminal with bash and curl: Mac and Linux already have them; on Windows, use WSL or Git Bash.
Clone the repository and go into the folder.
Pass the main address and the page paths, separated by spaces. Save the output to a file so you can compare it later.
It takes less than a minute on a small site.

exemplo.texto: Choose a product or service page and a new page that you haven't seen on Google yet.

texto: Canonical empty or different from the address? Internal links near zero? Meta robots with noindex on an important page? Each one becomes a finding.
Don't fix anything yet: just take notes.

exemplo.texto: A catalog page that became "search only" in the browser and left hundreds of pages with no links in the HTML.

texto: For each finding, copy the line of output that shows it and the lesson in this course that covers it.
That list is your plan for the next few weeks.

secoes.sub: Copy and run in the terminal. Replace the address with your own site's.

blocos.conteudo:
bash tools/auditoria.sh https://www.seusite.com /pagina-1/ /pagina-2/ > raio-x.txt
cat raio-x.txt

# X-ray of <yoursite.com> on <mm/dd/yyyy>
| finding | output line | lesson |
|---|---|---|
| <empty canonical on /pagina-1/> | canonical: | 4 |
| <page with no internal links> | links internos no HTML: 0 | 7 and course 2 |

abas.html:
Excerpt of auditoria.sh run on 10/19/2026 (robots.txt shortened):

== Redirecionamentos
  http://www.inema.club/ -> 308 https://www.inema.club/
  https://inema.club/ -> 308 https://www.inema.club/
  https://www.inema.club/ -> 200
== robots.txt
  User-Agent: *
  Allow: /
  (…)
== Sitemaps
  https://www.inema.club/sitemap.xml: 83 URLs, 60 anotações hreflang
  https://www.inema.club/courses-sitemap.xml: 100 URLs, 0 anotações hreflang
== llms.txt: 200
== Páginas
-- /cursos/  [200]
   title:     Cursos de inteligência artificial, agentes e automação | INEMA.club
   canonical: https://www.inema.club/cursos/
   hreflang:  hrefLang="en" hrefLang="es" hrefLang="pt-BR" hrefLang="x-default"
   links internos no HTML: 334
-- /conhecimento/  [200]
   canonical: https://www.inema.club/conhecimento/
   hreflang:
   links internos no HTML: 58

On 09/30/2026 (commit bc50d11), the /cursos/ page became "search only" and the 310 course cards lost the only internal link that came in the server's HTML. On screen, everything looked fine.

The fix (8229495) was a collapsed index inside <details> with all the links, with no visual change. The "links internos no HTML" line for /cursos/, above, is the snapshot after the fix.

• Looking only in the browser: what JavaScript builds may not exist for the bot.
  • Auditing only the home page: the problem is usually on the catalog page or the new one.
  • Fixing before writing it down: without the "before" snapshot, you can't tell if it got better.

secoes.sub: Keep raio-x.txt: lessons 4 to 8 compare against it.

exercicios.texto: Run the audit on the home page and 2 pages of your site, and save it to raio-x.txt.
exercicios.pronto: the file exists and has the Redirecionamentos, robots.txt, Sitemaps, and Páginas blocks.

exercicios.texto: Read the output and fill in the list of findings with at least 3 lines (if everything is fine, write down what you checked).
exercicios.pronto: each finding has the output line copied and the lesson that covers it.

secoes.sub: The explanation appears after you answer.

perguntas.p: Why does the X-ray use curl and not the browser?
opcoes: Because it shows the HTML the server delivers, without running JavaScript, the way the bot usually reads it.
Because the browser doesn't open websites.
perguntas.explica: The browser runs JavaScript and builds things the bot may not see. The X-ray shows the server's version, which is the basis for the search engine.

perguntas.p: The /cursos/ screen looked normal, but the course cards disappeared from the links. What showed the problem?
opcoes: The "links internos no HTML" line of the X-ray.
perguntas.explica: The browser search built the links with JavaScript; in the server's HTML they did not exist. The collapsed index brought the links back without changing the look.

perguntas.p: Does the X-ray change anything on your site?
opcoes: Only if you have a password.
perguntas.explica: It's read-only. That's why you can run it on any public site, including a competitor's or a client's, before you change anything.

perguntas.p: You found a problem in the X-ray. What's the next step in this lesson?
opcoes: Write it down with the output line and the lesson that covers it.
Run it again until it goes away.
Ignore it if the home page looks fine.
perguntas.explica: First the full picture, then the fix. The list of findings becomes the plan for the next lessons and the before-and-after comparison.

itens.texto: auditoria.sh reads the HTML from the server with curl and changes nothing.

itens.t: The line that catches the most
itens.texto: Internal links in the HTML: a page with no links barely exists to the search engine.
raio-x.txt + list of findings with the line and the lesson.
